concept.title: Firefox Release and ESR policy differences
concept.shortdesc: Use channel badges and the active schema channel to avoid configuring policies that are unavailable in the selected Firefox family.

section.title: Current channels
section.p: BPM 0.9.0 documents Firefox Release 152 and Firefox ESR 140.12. The generated policy references carry channel metadata so navigation, search indexes, and future filters can display the active channel honestly.

section.title: Support badges
section.p: A support badge in each generated policy reference states whether the policy is supported in both channels or only in Release. The badge is generated from the maintained Firefox policy inventory, not from translated prose.

section.title: Release-only policies
section.p: Eight current policies are Release-only: AIControls, BrowserDataBackup, DisableRemoteImprovements, GenerativeAI, IPProtectionAvailable, LocalNetworkAccess, VisualSearchEnabled, and XSLTEnabled. When the active schema is ESR 140.12, BPM must treat these as unavailable.

section.title: Changed definitions
section.p: The current inventory has no common policy whose schema definition differs between Release 152 and ESR 140.12. Future schema refreshes must update this statement through the generated channel-differences artifact.

section.title: User action
section.p: Select the Firefox schema channel before choosing a policy, verify the channel badge, and revalidate before export. Do not use a Release-only topic as evidence that the same policy is supported by ESR.
